notes.title: The Alienversary is here! (along with updates)
notes.content: [h1]The E.T. is a jolly good fellow![/h1][p]Exactly one year ago Alien Paradise was released, and not only I wanted to celebrate this achievement but also add important updates, with a special surprise:[/p][h2]Random Mode[/h2][h3]Yes, a new mode![/h3][p]When playing in the "Quickplay" area, some levels will show the "Random Mode" option. Playing in this way, you won't have to know when the animations will occur.[/p][p]A little reminder that the scores obtained in this mode [b]don't[/b] count for the Leaderboards.[/p][p][/p][p]Among this new feature, those changes were implemented:[/p][list][*][p][b]Leaderboards[/b]: guess who's back, now using Steam's structure, to guaranteeit'll work in the best way possible. Remember that it only accounts for the scores from the Quickplay area while the Leaderboards are on.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New title screen[/b]: giving more dynamism and energy when opening the game, while also you have the option of changing the game's language to make the life of anyone who wants to learn a foreign language easier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller navigation fixes[/b]: some problems when navigating using a controller were found in the Quickplay screen and solved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wrong menu bug fix[/b]: solved an issue when player would be redirected to the wrong menu (going to the Story Mode while being in Quickplay).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Button selection more blatant[/b]: to avoid doubt, the selected interface button now changes size and gets a more noticeable outline.[/p][/*][*][p]And more subtle fixes and enhancements.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p]I want to thank to everyone who have played Alien Paradise so much in this one year period, and to those who met the game before it "arrived our planet". And if you're getting to know the game now, welcome and I hope you have a lot of fun 😁🥰[/p]

notes.title: New languages! (and bug fixes)
notes.content:
In this Alien Paradise update, players who speak Spanish, French or Japanese can travel Brazil with the most synasthesic and touristic alien in the galaxy in your prefered language

This update also solves the following issues:
[list]
[*] Error that were stopping players from unlocking the achievements "No Help Needed" and "Three's a Lot!"
[*] Navigation problems when leaving the Settings screen, that could send the player back to the wrong mode
[*] Being sent back to the Story Mode while playing Quickplay if the level was played again
[/list]

notes.title: Carry your Alien anywhere
notes.content:
Alien Paradise was developed to be a light game, easy to run in the majority of computers running WIndows or Linix, but the developer also thought on the SteamDeck experience.

[list]
[*] For the commands used in the levels, the player can use the A and B buttos, the directional button to the left and right or the triggers, giving as many options that may be the most comfortable for each player.
[*] The menu navigation can be done using the game controls or touching the screen directly.
[*] All phases were tested to guarantee the game performance wouldn't be downgraded running on the device.
[/list]

So, if you have a SteamDeck, you can use it to have a synasthesic experience with Alien Paradise on the go.

notes.title: October 2024 - More clarification
notes.content:
Small but important changes were added to the game, giving even more clarity to the gameplay and general experience.

The specific list of fixes includes:
[list]
[*]False hit animations: animations that are displayed when you press a button too early or late won't appear over the mistake animation
[*]Overclick: the code handles the "overclick" message to avoid information duplicity
[*]Pause key: the game gives a quick heads up on how to call the pause screen (it's always been in the game, but some players didn't know that
[*]AV/Sync option: this settings option was enhanced with more info for better clarification on how to use the controls and better performance in-game
[*]And other smaller fixes
[/list]

notes.title: New update: QoL enhancements
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Clearer feedbacks: if you overclick, the game displays the information in a less confusing way, as the overclick messages don't overwrite the hit or miss feedback
[*]Music on repeat: background music for some of the navigation screens don't stop abruptly when reaching its looping point
[*]Legal stuff: some important information regarding copyright was added to the game credits
[*]Minor enhancements and fixes
[/list]
